connection_type.description: Type of connection to the phone/modem. Choose 'serial', 'bluetooth', or 'at' (AT command set).

port.description: Device path (serial), Bluetooth MAC address (for bluetooth connection), or generic port string.

connection_speed.description: Baud rate for serial/AT connection. Set only if needed (ignored for Bluetooth).

bluetooth_address.description: Bluetooth MAC address (e.g., '00:11:22:33:44:55') — required only when connection_type = 'bluetooth'.

model.description: Modem/phone model (e.g., 'Nokia 3310'). Leave blank for auto-detection.

connection.description: Manufacturer name (e.g., 'nokia', 'siemens'). Optional, used to hint driver selection.

smsc.description: SMS Center (SMSC) phone number in international format (e.g., '+1234567890'). Required for SMS sending.

db_type.description: Database backend for SMS storage. Supported: 'mysql', 'sqlite3', 'postgresql'.

db_host.description: Database server hostname/IP — used only for 'mysql' and 'postgresql'.

db_file.description: Path to SQLite3 database file — used only when db_type = 'sqlite3'.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Set to empty string ('') to disable file logging.

loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = none, 1 = errors, 2 = warnings, 3 = info, 4 = debug.

smsd_poll_interval.description: Seconds between inbox polling. Use 0 if hardware interrupt support (e.g., IrDA or serial CD/DSR) is available.

max_retry.description: Max number of retries for sending a failed SMS.

sentfolder.description: Directory path for archiving sent SMS files (optional).

inboxfolder.description: Directory path for archiving received SMS files (optional).

archive.description: Whether to archive sent SMS messages to the database (true/false).
